headline: Lease of parking lot fronting Broad and North Union streets to Joshua Café, LLC d/b/a News Café, and a Narragansett Electric easement.
summary: The committee will consider a six-month lease, followed by month-to-month tenancy, for a parking area lot. It will also consider an easement with Narragansett Electric Company for an underground distribution system at 100 Freight Street.
items: Resolution authorizing the Mayor to enter into a lease agreement with Joshua Café, LLC d/b/a News Café for a six (6) month term, followed by a month-to-month tenancy, for the parking area lot fronting on Broad Street and North Union Street

Resolution authorizing the City of Pawtucket to enter into an easement agreement with Narragansett Electric Company to maintain an underground distribution system for the property at 100 Freight Street (Assessor's Plat 8, Lot 417)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, City Council Conference Room - Room 140, 100 Freight Street, 1st Floor, Pawtucket, Rhode Island

AGENDA 
 
TO:  All Members of the City Property Committee

John Marques, Proprietor, Joshua’s LLC d/b/a News Café 
 
FROM:       Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE:          October 15, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: CITY PROPERTY COMMITTEE  
 
 
 
You are  requested to attend a meeting of the City Council City Property  Committee, to be held on  
Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 6:15 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street , 1st 
Floor, City Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A LEASE AGREEMENT WITH 
JOSHUA CAFÉ, LLC D/B/A NEWS CAFÉ FOR A TERM OF SIX (6) MONTHS FOLLOWED BY 
A MONTH-TO-MONTH TENANCY FOR THE PARKING AREA LOT FRONTING ON BROAD 
STREET AND NORTH UNION STREET 
 
3. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET TO ENTER INTO AN EASEMENT 
AGREEMENT WITH NARRAGANSETT ELECTRIC COMPANY TO MAINTAIN AN 
UNDERGROUND DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 100 
FREIGHT STREET (ASSESSOR’S PLAT 8, LOT 417) 
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor Marlena Martins Stachowiak, Chair, City Property Committee.
